policy.authenticated_reconstruction_requires: all six gates pass and written manual review
policy.partial_reconstruction_requires: identity_and_role and name_tied_multiview pass; every unsupported feature remains explicit
policy.freeze_rule: No original-labelled silhouette redesign may advance beyond its gate_status without new ledger evidence.
policy.count_semantics: Implementation counts; a written evidence specification alone does not count as an implemented reconstruction.
policy.name_to_model_status_semantics: name_to_model_status is the historical-confidence label for tying this class name to a visible craft. It must be drawn from evidence_status_vocabulary and may only be raised when the source ledger gains a registered anchor that ties the name to a craft. An implementation, a render, a test pass or an attractive silhouette never raises it.
policy.model_sources_semantics: model_sources lists registered sources accepted as name-to-model evidence for this ship. name_only_sources lists registered sources that record the class label string but tie no visible craft to it; a name_only_source is never geometry evidence.
policy.implementation_status_semantics: implementation_status describes what exists in the runtime, not historical confidence. provisional_modern_candidate_frozen maps to the provisional_candidate vocabulary status and requires name_to_model_status 'unknown'.

The B3 Arrow label is registered only as part of the bulk claim fleet.labels_titan_torrent_arrow_altair_katana; the ledger holds no frame or timestamp anchor for it, and B3's registered anchors (f1860, f1879) demonstrate the opposite — a regeneration label changing over an unchanged visible craft.
unknowns: whether any registered footage shows an Arrow at all
whether the class survived past the 2009-11-12 A3 capture
ships.next_evidence_gate: A registered frame anchor that holds an empty berth through the Arrow label and then shows one craft appear, followed by two or more tied views, or creator-authored Arrow model imagery.
